caption: The drawing features a small, round object centrally positioned on an otherwise blank, off-white background. The object appears to be a purse or pouch with a decorative, gold-colored clasp along its top edge. The body of the purse is divided into sections of distinct color patterns. The upper section shows a landscape with small yellow houses with red and blue roofs, set against green trees and a blue sky. Below this is a horizontal black stripe separating the landscape scene from the lower half of the object, which is mainly red and adorned with repetitive, yellow-green motifs spaced evenly in rows. There is a thin, blue horizontal stripe above the red section. The artist's signature, "Romano," appears in small text to the bottom right of the object.
title: Beaded Purse
